title: Email overload: exploring personal information management of email
abstract: An empirical study of email use showing that inboxes serve not only communication but also task management and archiving functions. Outstanding tasks and ongoing conversational threads coexist with other messages, creating problems of status tracking and overlooked important information.

title: EPIC: A multi-tiered approach to enterprise email prioritization
abstract: Presents a personalized enterprise-email priority classifier using message content, topic and user models, organizational information, and interaction history. It combines global and user-specific models and evaluates personalized email-priority prediction, but does not independently establish response obligations.

title: Evolutionary timeline summarization: A balanced optimization framework via iterative substitution
abstract: Constructs an evolutionary sequence of dated summaries while balancing relevance, coverage, coherence, and cross-date diversity. It is transfer evidence for reducing temporal redundancy while retaining coverage, rather than direct evidence for workplace work-item persistence.
